replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body:
I'm sorry, But the judges for the map building contest have decided to deny your map for the following reasons:

-  People can easily be knocked off. Pathways connecting spawn to the center point are rather small, and hard for multiple people to cross at a time. These pathways are really thin in other words, and people can easily fall off or be knocked off. It would be hard for people to reach spawn, providing poor gameplay.
- Are your aesthetics the best? Each spawn structure is something really basic and simple, along with the look of the center structure.
- Blocks used. There are so many different and various blocks used, it doesn't fit well with good aesthetics.
- Making revisions based on these points would make this map an excellent one, keep with the good work though! :)

Aesthetics -  2/5
Gameplay - 2/5 
Creativity -  1/5

Thank you for submitting your map! I hope you participate in our next building competition!
